symptom: The first cloud ticket failure ended an explicit open even when a short retry succeeded. Cancellation was not forwarded to ticket fetch, ticket time extended the open deadline, late checkout replies could publish after Stop, and a failed reconnect ticket consumed a sequence so the next success was rejected.
rule: bug-fix.md and principles 1, 6, 7: retry only transient ticket acquisition with a bounded attempt count and nonzero backoff; carry one original open deadline; observe account generation, owner tombstones and persistent Stop versions throughout requests, waits and final publication; keep reconnects passive and advance their sequence only when acquisition succeeds.
